extraction_warnings.message: SEC Company Facts exposes no single consolidated period-end common shares outstanding fact for both share classes; weighted-average basic and diluted shares are retained instead.
The automatically fetched DEFA14A is a supplemental proxy filing and may not contain the full executive compensation tables.
Inline XBRL facts were linked by accession to the fetched filings; page numbers and verbatim table quotes are unavailable, so XBRL concept and period locators are used.
